title: Sparse and Low-Dimensional Models for High-Dimensional Data
description: Recommended: ELEN E4810 or equivalent. Overview of theory, computation and applications for sparse and low-dimensional data modeling. Recoverability of sparse and low-rank models. Optimization methods for low-dim data modeling. Applications to imaging, neuroscience, communications, web data
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ELEN E4815 ; or equivalent and linear algebra.
